title: KV260 persistent runtime repair review plan
decision_gate: Read-only UART inspection found no ZOCL in initramfs or boot DTBs and no explicit modules-load/modprobe/udev/systemd load rule. The manager's ExecStartPre only checks the default firmware marker and directory. Candidate loader is ordered after systemd-modules-load and udev-trigger/daemon but before dfx-mgr.service with Requires/After. Do not mark deployment complete until unit syntax/dependencies are statically checked and a reboot confirms candidate srcversion and parameter before the official app overlay is initialized.
